source.title: Duskwood Mission XIV: Defeat Vvarc'zul
source.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Vul'gol Ogre Mound. Defeat the ogre warlord Vvarc'zul there and return to me.
source.objective: Defeat Vvarc'zul in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursion deep in the Vul'gol Ogre Mound and return to Field Captain Palandar.
source.completion: Well done! Your services shall be well rewarded. Perhaps another mission?
